subjects.description: A car (viewed from the driver's perspective/dashcam) traveling along a coastal mountain road. The vehicle's grey dashboard and windshield frame are visible at the bottom of the frame.
subjects.appearance_details: Grey/dark interior dashboard, windshield wipers visible, clean windshield providing clear view of the road ahead
subjects.relationship: Primary subject and point-of-view vehicle navigating the mountain road
subjects.location: Bottom foreground, providing the POV perspective
subjects.relative_size: Large within frame (dashboard occupies bottom portion)
subjects.orientation: Facing forward along the road direction
subjects.action: Driving fast along the curved coastal road, then making a sudden emergency stop
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from fast forward motion to abrupt deceleration and complete stop

subjects.description: A deer stepping out of the roadside ferns on the left and crossing the road in front of the car
subjects.appearance_details: Adult deer with a reddish-brown coat, pale underside and white tail, slender legs, ears alert, brushing past green ferns as it emerges
subjects.relationship: Animal crossing that forces the car to brake hard and stop
subjects.location: Emerges from the ferns at the left road edge, then moves across the center of the road ahead
subjects.relative_size: Small at first, growing to medium within frame as the car closes in
subjects.orientation: Side profile, moving from left to right across the road
subjects.action: Steps out of the roadside ferns on the left and walks across the road
subjects.state_changes: Hidden in the ferns, then stepping onto the asphalt, then crossing the lane in front of the car

background_setting: A dramatic coastal mountain highway carved along steep rocky cliffs. The road is a well-maintained two-lane highway with white dashed center lines, solid white edge lines, and raised reflective road markers. A metal guardrail runs along the right side protecting from a drop toward the ocean. The mountain rises steeply on the left with exposed grey and brown rock faces partially covered with lush green native vegetation including ferns and shrubs. The ocean is visible in the distance to the right under a partly cloudy blue sky. The road curves sharply to the left around the mountain headland.

lighting.conditions: Bright natural daylight with partly cloudy skies, strong ambient illumination
lighting.direction: Top-lit and slightly front-lit from the sun positioned high in the sky
lighting.shadows: Moderate shadows cast by the mountain cliff creating areas of shade on the road and vegetation, soft shadows from clouds
lighting.illumination_effect: Bright, clear visibility with good contrast between the sunlit road surface and shaded mountain areas, natural coastal light

aesthetics.composition: Driver's POV/dashcam perspective with the road curving ahead as the central leading line, mountain dominating the upper-left portion, ocean visible to the right, dashboard framing the bottom
aesthetics.color_scheme: Dominant greens from vegetation, grey-brown rocky cliff faces, dark grey asphalt road with white markings, blue sky and ocean, yellow warning sign providing accent color
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Initially scenic and adventurous, turning tense and startling as the deer steps into the road
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating metal guardrail posts along the right side, dashed center line markings, layered rock strata on the cliff face

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective with slight vibration from vehicle speed, sudden forward lurch during emergency braking
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver's POV through windshield
cinematography.focus: Road ahead and mountain cliff face in sharp focus

artistic_style: Realistic dashcam footage, dramatic documentary style
context: Dashcam footage of a deer stepping out of the roadside ferns and crossing a coastal mountain highway, forcing the driver to brake hard and stop

actions.description: The car drives fast along the winding coastal mountain road, approaching the left curve with the road rushing beneath
A deer steps out of the roadside ferns on the left and walks onto the road ahead, crossing in front of the car as the driver brakes hard
The car comes to a complete stop, the camera lurching forward from the deceleration, as the deer finishes crossing the road ahead

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Black arrow on yellow diamond-shaped warning sign, mounted on a metal pole
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Left side of road, visible from 0:00 and passing by as car moves forward
text_and_signage_elements.context: Road warning sign indicating a sharp left curve ahead, standard highway signage

segments.description: The car speeds along the scenic coastal mountain highway, navigating the curve. The road surface rushes beneath, white lines blur slightly from speed, and the mountain looms ahead.
segments.key_changes: Road perspective shifts as car navigates the curve, passing the warning sign, guardrail moves in peripheral view
segments.camera: Forward-moving dashcam with slight road vibration, steady forward momentum

segments.description: The ferns at the left road edge part and a deer steps out onto the asphalt, walking across the lane in front of the car. The driver brakes hard and the car decelerates sharply.
segments.key_changes: Deer appears from the ferns and moves into the car's path, road ahead goes from clear to blocked, rapid deceleration begins
segments.camera: Still moving forward but slowing sharply, camera pitches forward as the brakes bite

segments.description: The car comes to a complete stop. The camera settles after the forward lurch, with the deer just ahead finishing its crossing toward the right side of the road.
segments.key_changes: Motion stops completely, camera settles, deer reaches the far side of the lane
segments.camera: Abrupt forward pitch from braking, then stabilizes to static as vehicle stops

temporal_caption: The video begins with a dashcam view of a car driving fast along a scenic coastal mountain road, the asphalt rushing beneath and a sharp left curve sign visible on the left. Around the 2-second mark, a deer steps out of the roadside ferns on the left and walks onto the road, crossing in front of the car. The driver brakes hard and the camera lurches forward from the sudden deceleration. By second 4-5 the car has come to a complete stop, with the deer just ahead finishing its crossing toward the right side of the road.
audio_description: Initially the sound of a car engine at moderate-high RPM and tire noise on asphalt with wind passing over the vehicle. Around second 2, a rustle of ferns at the roadside, followed immediately by the sharp screech of tires braking hard on asphalt and the engine dropping off. By second 4 the car is stopped: the engine idles quietly, with soft hooves on the road and wind in the vegetation.
